text.description_html:
Omnia AP-9013P/415, Solid Brass Urban Refrigerator Handle

"Oh wow," they'll say as they enter your kitchen on the way to grab a bottle of champagne to celebrate your new home. The Urban Appliance Pull is definitely a showstopper; and in modern homes, it is the finishing detail that shows you have an eye for design and sleek, simple lines. Okay, so maybe it isn't a new home you're toasting, and maybe its not champagne you're going to the kitchen to get. Maybe its the baby's bottle at 2 in the morning. Whatever the case maybe, you can feel good about your space. It is the littlest details that transform a house into something more personal. Everyone considers cabinet hardware, but the door in the kitchen that is opened the most is the refrigerator. Make sure yours reflects your personal style. At 17-15/16" it is long enough for use on larger doors; and as you might have guessed, this pull isn't just for refrigerators. You can use it on other appliances like oven doors as well as all around your home. It is constructed out of solid brass and is available in satin nickel, polished chrome, and oil-rubbed bronze.

Also Available: Matching Urban Kitchen Cabinet Pull

Specifications of the Urban Refrigerator Pull:

  • Material: Brass
  • Length (center to center): 16-5/16" (c.c.)
  • Overall Length: 17-15/16"
  • Max Thickness: 3/4"
  • Max Projection: 1-7/8"
  • Pull Mounting: Standard 3/4" Thick Appliance Panel

Sold Individually
